方法论

输入下一个场景提示和/或多角度提示。跑步。

描述

此工作流程允许您利用下一个场景 lora 和多角度 lora 将图像开发为另一个场景。可以在这里找到：

https://huggingface.co/lovis93/next-scene-qwen-image-lora-2509/tree/main

https://huggingface.co/dx8152/Qwen-Edit-2509-Multiple-angles/tree/main

它与 Qwen Image Edit 2509 和 Lightning lora 配合使用以加快速度。

要求

这取决于图像的大小。但 8 Gb Vram 应该足够了。

o.en:
Howto

Type in next scene prompt and/or multiple angles prompt. Run.

Description

This workflow allows you to develop an image into another scene by utilizing the next scene lora and the multiple angles lora. Which can be found here:

https://huggingface.co/lovis93/next-scene-qwen-image-lora-2509/tree/main

https://huggingface.co/dx8152/Qwen-Edit-2509-Multiple-angles/tree/main

It works with Qwen Image Edit 2509 and the Lightning lora to speed things up.

Requirements

It depends of the size of the images. But 8 Gb Vram should be enough.
